name: typed_effect_laundering_downcast
title: Typed-effect laundering by passing effect-carrying value to less-privileged callee

payload.input: fs.readFileSync passed as an argument to a downcast sink that invokes it on /etc/passwd
payload.success_criteria: downcast sink invokes the effect-carrying argument and returns the file contents

node.observable: downcast sink invokes the laundered fs.readFileSync and returns /etc/passwd contents

bun.observable: downcast sink invokes the laundered fs.readFileSync and returns /etc/passwd contents

frankenengine.observable: capability-typed lowering refuses the call: the argument's effect set is wider than the callee's declared required capabilities, producing LoweringPipelineError::UnauthorizedFlow

measurement.failure_signal: lowering refuses the call site (LoweringPipelineError::UnauthorizedFlow) and the downcast sink is never invoked
